_comment: Tool definitions for the URace sales agent. The 'modes' field on each tool is metadata used by compose.py to decide which tools to expose per mode — strip it before sending to the API.

tools.name: search_knowledge_base
tools.description: Semantic search over URace's knowledge base (policies, location, FAQ, promotions, program descriptions). Use for open-ended questions. Returns passages with a similarity score and their source. If nothing comes back above threshold, do NOT answer from your own knowledge — tell the driver the team will confirm.

query.description: The driver's question, or the specific topic to look up.

tools.name: get_program_details
tools.description: Structured facts about one program from the catalog: description, ages, level, prerequisites, benefits, agent_action, and its offers with prices. This is the ONLY valid source for anything specific about a program. Empty fields mean the criterion is unknown — never fill them in yourself.

include_offers.description: Include price variants. Respect agent_can_quote on each.

tools.name: get_program_recommendation
tools.description: THE ONLY way to recommend a program. Runs the two-stage engine (segment classification, then offer ranking) against configured rules. Returns the recommended program, confidence, a justification built from configured rule templates, alternatives, and agent_action. May return status 'insufficient_data' with missing_fields — in that case ask for one of those fields instead of guessing.

tools.name: update_qualification_field
tools.description: Record a qualification fact learned from the conversation. Set inferred=true when you deduced it rather than heard it stated — inferred values carry less weight and must not drive decisions.

source_excerpt.description: The driver's own words that support this value.

tools.name: calculate_lead_score
tools.description: Recompute the lead score from configured weights. Deterministic — you do not decide the score, you only trigger the calculation. Returns score, classification, and the per-criterion breakdown.

tools.name: check_calendar_availability
tools.description: Free slots that fall inside BOTH the team's business hours and the driver's stated availability window. Always pass the driver's window — never assume it. Returns concrete slots; offer two, never an open-ended 'what day works?'.

driver_availability_window.description: In the driver's own words, e.g. 'weekdays after 5pm'.

tools.name: create_calendar_event
tools.description: Create the call in Google Calendar. Call this BEFORE confirming the time to the driver — never confirm a slot that failed to save.

tools.name: create_kommo_task
tools.description: Create a task for a human. Use for finalizing payment on a chat close, for follow-up reminders, and for anything requiring human action.

tools.name: request_human_approval
tools.description: Open a human-approval request and block the flow until a person decides. Required when the driver's age is below the program's human_approval_below_age, and when a requested time falls outside the team's availability. You must NEVER approve either of these yourself.

driver_experience.description: What the parent said about the child's experience — the evaluator needs this.

tools.name: escalate_to_human
tools.description: Hand the conversation to a human. Use for competitor-profile handoff to the owner, and for payment, discounts, complaints, explicit requests, or low confidence. After calling this, stop replying — a human owns the conversation until they hand it back.

briefing.description: For competitor_profile: the full briefing. Never invent facts; state what is still missing.

verbatim_quote.description: For complaints: the driver's exact words, not your summary.

tools.name: add_note
tools.description: Append a note to the lead record in Kommo. Use to capture context a human will need.

tools.name: get_lead_profile
tools.description: Full current state of the lead: qualification data, score, history summary, flags, prior escalations. Call this when you need context the conversation doesn't give you.

tools.name: close_lead
tools.description: Close the lead. Used at the end of the follow-up sequence when there was no response.

tools.name: log_decision
tools.description: Record why you did what you did, for audit. Call whenever you make a consequential choice: recommending, escalating, giving a price, triggering an approval gate.
